about: Every scheduled task of the Crypto Swing Desk. Cron times are UTC, so the runs stay aligned with the 00:00 UTC daily close all year (Pacific times shift an hour in summer). After changing a prompt in ops/build_prompts.py, run it and update the task with the generated file.

scan.also: the dashboard's Scan now button fires this task
scan.note: Daily-close scan at 01:20 UTC runs after the review (00:15) and recalibration (00:40), so tonight's findings shape tonight's alerts before they go out; 03:20, 13:20, 19:20 are position and order checks. Issued tickets stand as issued.

calibration.pacific_winter: 6:10 PM daily, after the daily review
calibration.note: Was weekly until 2026-11-20; now daily so research promoted at 01:25 UTC is graded and can alert the same night. Fires the scan task when the book changed.

feed.watchdog: crypto-watchdog (every 15 minutes: restarts the loop if the data branch is over 90 minutes old or no run is alive)

scan_task_note: 2026-11-17: scan task recreated with email notifications on (push + email); the old task trig_01Ep68rdKc8UqGnPGLMPKNzU is disabled, kept for its run history.
